- Call `list_users()` to confirm existence of Bob.
- Call `get_user_id({"user":"Bob"})`.
- Locate notes file: maybe "notes.txt".
- Read it: `cat({"file_name": "notes.txt"})`
- Then send message: `send_message({"receiver_id": bob_id, "message": notes_content})`
